{{Quote|Wait! Shoran has spotted an excursion of Trade Federation troops.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=ShoranHasSpotted.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
During the [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] for the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] fought by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]], a [[Chewbacca's camp|camp]] run by the Wookiee [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] was '''attacked''' by a group of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by [[LUH-989]]. Chewbacca was warned of the attack by his ally [[Shoran]], giving him [[Time/Legends|time]] to rally his [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] at the edge of the camp. All of the attacking [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] were [[Death/Legends|destroyed]], and afterward Chewbacca and Shoran's forces [[Attack on the Trade Federation listening array|destroyed]] a [[Trade Federation listening array|listening array]] belonging to the Trade Federation, ultimately [[Battle for Alaris Prime|driving]] them from Alaris Prime.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Good, now send&hellip;|Qui-Gon Jinn's instructions interrupted by Shoran's sighting of the approaching battle droids|audio=GoodNowSend.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
Sometime between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Alaris/Legends|Alaris]] in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]], was engulfed in a [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] between its [[Alaris Prime colonization resolution|rightful]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] and the company known as the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. After the Wookiees [[Attack on the Trade Federation outpost|destroyed]] a [[Trade Federation outpost]], the leader of the [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], was present at a [[Chewbacca's camp|camp]] near a [[Shoran's camp|settlement]] run by his ally, [[Shoran]]. At the instructions of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], who was appointed by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as an [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] to the Wookiees, Chewbacca had his workers build a [[Jedi temple (Alaris Prime)|Jedi temple]] within his camp. Upon its construction Jinn's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], arrived on Alaris Prime to collect a [[Jedi holocron (Alaris Prime)|Jedi holocron]] found in Shoran's camp.<ref name="GB" />

Immediately after Kenobi entered Shoran's camp, the Wookiee discovered a group of [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] that was remotely [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by the [[Battle droid/Legends|droid]] [[LUH-989]] heading for Chewbacca's camp. Upon learning of that fact, Jinn suggested that they sound a warning alarm to send the workers at the camp to safety,<ref name="GB" /> while between five and six Wookiees,<ref name="Prima" /> including Chewbacca and at least two [[bowcaster trooper]]s and a [[dragon trooper]], waited at the edge of the camp to engage the [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="GB" />

==The attack==
{{Quote|Garrison your workers and ready your fighting Wookiees!|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=GarrisonWorkers.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
LUH-989's three [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]]-wielding [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|beetle droids]] arrived at the camp and were [[Death/Legends|destroyed]] by the Wookiees' [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcasters]] and flamethrowers. Six [[Battle Droid Beta Version]]s then marched in with [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifles]] and met the same fate. Shoran's camp was also affected by the attack.<ref name="GB" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Shoran has asked for some nova crystals to help him recover from the Trade Federation attack. He warned us of the attack, it's the least we can do.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=ShoranNeeds.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
Shoran requested assistance in recovering from the attack in the form of one hundred [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]], which Jinn agreed to provide as thanks for alerting Chewbacca to the attack. Shoran reciprocated by offering one hundred units of [[Ore/Legends|ore]] in return. Kenobi also returned from Shoran's camp carrying the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]], which he stored in the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] temple where it could generate more nova crystals for the Wookiees. Jinn recommended that the Wookiees train more [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] for any future attacks. Afterward, [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] from Shoran's camp found a [[Trade Federation listening array|listening array]] also commanded by LUH-989, and forces from Chewbacca and Shoran's camps combined to [[Attack on the Trade Federation listening array|destroy]] it. The Trade Federation forces were later expelled from the moon in the [[Battle for Alaris Prime]].<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Chewbacca is dead! We cannot continue.|Qui-Gon Jinn, if the player fails|audio=ChewieDead3.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The attack on Chewbacca's camp was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' by [[Steven L. Kent]],<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>&mdash;released on [[November 7]], [[2001]]<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref>&mdash;before appearing in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="GB" /> released on [[November 11]], 2001.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> The attack takes place in the sixth level of the Wookiee tutorial campaign, entitled "Allies and Jedi." The attack is a scripted event triggered when Obi-Wan Kenobi passes through the gates of Shoran's camp to collect the holocron. At the beginning of the level, the player has four combat ready units: Chewbacca, two bowcaster troopers, and one dragon trooper. Other units available for the player to create include [[Thermal detonator trooper (Wookiee)|grenade troopers]], [[HummBike|speeder bike scouts]], and Jedi Padawans.<ref name="GB" />

While Jinn recommends the player garrison their worker units in the base's [[command center]] for their safety in the game,<ref name="GB" /> the strategy guide indicates that such an action is unnecessary due to the small size of the invading force. The guide states that only five or six Wookiees are necessary for victory and that the level is difficult to lose, although the player will fail if Chewbacca is killed.<ref name="Prima" />
